profile_notes: Event & wedding glass — fast, versatile, quiet. GATE: max_aperture <= 2.8 only (a fast aperture IS the event-lens requirement — dim venues + subject separation; f/2.8-or-faster is the honest floor). Focal DELIBERATELY NOT gated: event shooters run the gamut (35mm environmental, 50/85 candids, 24-70 & 70-200/2.8 zooms) — the common thread is speed, not focal length, so gating focal would wrongly exclude legitimate event glass. CRUX (triple, at 2): af_performance (reliable low-light AF on moving candid subjects), optical_performance (sharp wide-open, where event lenses live), and bokeh (subject separation from busy venue backgrounds — the event look). SUPPORTING at 1: af_noise (QUIET autofocus during silent ceremonies/vows is a genuine event-lens differentiator, unique to this profile), color_rendition (skin tones under mixed venue light), chromatic_aberration (backlit hair, stage lights). Deliberately UNWEIGHTED: coma, vignetting, distortion, filter_thread, build, handling. gear_class excludes novelty only. DISTINCT-FINGERPRINT CHECK: shares the f<=2.8 gate with portrait lenses but does NOT gate focal>=50 (events need fast wides too) and spreads weight across af/optical/bokeh + the unique af_noise, rather than portrait's bokeh-3 lead. Ratified by Lee 2026-09-15.
